title: दशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 110 · The rules of sacrifice and conduct

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks for the sacrifices told by Bhishma to be set out with their fruits here and hereafter. Bhishma answers that the poor man can win the fruit of sacrifices by self-restraint, that one should not covet another's wife nor lie, and gives a long account of the merits of every vow, concluding that those free of deceit and malice and steady need have no doubt.
summary.kn: ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳಿದ ಯಜ್ಞಗಳನ್ನು ಇಹ-ಪರ ಫಲಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸಲು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಬಡವ ಸಂಯಮದಿಂದ ಯಜ್ಞ ಫಲ ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು, ಪರಸ್ತ್ರೀ ಬಯಸಬಾರದು, ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳಬಾರದು ಎಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ರತದ ಪುಣ್ಯ, ವಂಚನೆ-ದ್ವೇಷ ರಹಿತ ಸ್ಥಿರರಿಗೆ ಸಂಶಯವಿಲ್ಲ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर भीष्म द्वारा कहे यज्ञों को इस लोक और परलोक के फल सहित समझाने को कहते हैं। भीष्म कहते हैं कि निर्धन संयम से यज्ञफल पा सकता है, परस्त्री की इच्छा या झूठ न करे, और प्रत्येक व्रत के गुण बताकर कहते हैं कि छल-द्रोह रहित स्थिर लोगों के लिए संशय नहीं।
summary.te: భీష్ముడు చెప్పిన యజ్ఞాలను ఇహపర ఫలాలతో వివరించమని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. పేదవాడు సంయమంతో యజ్ఞ ఫలం పొందగలడని, పరస్త్రీని కోరకూడదని, అబద్ధం చెప్పకూడదని భీష్ముడు చెప్పి, ప్రతి వ్రతం గుణాలు వివరించి, దంభం, ద్రోహం లేని స్థిరులకు సందేహం లేదంటాడు.
summary.ta: பீஷ்மர் கூறிய வேள்விகளை இம்மை மறுமைப் பலன்களுடன் விளக்குமாறு யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, ஏழை அடக்கத்தால் வேள்வியின் பலன் பெறலாம், பிறன்மனையை விரும்பக்கூடாது, பொய் கூறக்கூடாது என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறி, ஒவ்வொரு நோன்பின் பயன்களையும் சொல்லி வஞ்சனையும் பகையும் அற்ற உறுதியானவருக்கு ஐயமில்லை என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ഭീഷ്മർ പറഞ്ഞ യാഗങ്ങൾ, ഇഹലോകത്തിലെയും പരലോകത്തിലെയും ഫലങ്ങളോടൊപ്പം വിശദമായി പറയണമെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു. ദരിദ്രനായ മനുഷ്യനും ആത്മനിയന്ത്രണത്തിലൂടെ യാഗങ്ങളുടെ ഫലം നേടാമെന്നും, മറ്റൊരുവന്റെ ഭാര്യയെ മോഹിക്കുകയോ കള്ളം പറയുകയോ അരുതെന്നും ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു. ഓരോ വ്രതത്തിന്റെയും പുണ്യത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് അദ്ദേഹം നീണ്ട വിവരണം നൽകുന്നു; വഞ്ചനയും വിദ്വേഷവുമില്ലാതെ സ്ഥിരചിത്തരായവർക്ക് ഒരു സംശയവും വേണ്ടെന്ന് പറഞ്ഞ് അദ്ദേഹം അവസാനിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.110; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
पितामहेन विधिवद्यज्ञाः प्रोक्ता महात्मना ।
गुणाश्चैषां यथातत्त्वं प्रेत्य चेह च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, you have properly explained the sacrifices, and fully and truly their merits, both here and after death.

verses.text:
न ते शक्या दरिद्रेण यज्ञाः प्राप्तुं पितामह ।
बहूपकरणा यज्ञा नानासंभारविस्तराः ॥

meaning.en: But a poor man cannot perform those sacrifices, grandfather, which need many implements and a vast array of materials.

verses.text:
पार्थिवै राजपुत्रैर्वा शक्याः प्राप्तुं पितामह ।
नार्थन्यूनैरवगुणैरेकात्मभिरसंहतैः ॥

meaning.en: Kings and princes can perform them, grandfather, but not those short of wealth, lacking helpers, and alone and unsupported.

verses.text:
यो दरिद्रैरपि विधिः शक्यः प्राप्तुं सदा भवेत् ।
तुल्यो यज्ञफलैरेतैस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Tell me, grandfather, what rule might always be within the reach even of the poor, that equals these sacrifices in fruit.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
इदमङ्गिरसा प्रोक्तमुपवासफलात्मकम् ।
विधिं यज्ञफलैस्तुल्यं तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, learn this rule that Angiras taught, whose substance is the fruit of fasting and which equals the fruits of sacrifices.

verses.text:
यस्तु कल्यं तथा सायं भुञ्जानो नान्तरा पिबेत् ।
अहिंसानिरतो नित्यं जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats in the morning and evening, drinks nothing in between, is ever devoted to non-violence and offers oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
षड्भिरेव तु वर्षैः स सिध्यते नात्र संशयः ।
तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णं च विमानं लभते नरः ॥

meaning.en: attains perfection in just six years, without doubt, and gains a celestial car the colour of molten gold.

verses.text:
देवस्त्रीणामधीवासे नृत्यगीतनिनादिते ।
प्राजापत्ये वसेत्पद्मं वर्षाणामग्निसंनिभे ॥

meaning.en: In the realm of the divine women, resounding with dance and song, he dwells for a padma of years in the fiery realm of Prajapati.

verses.text:
त्रीणि वर्षाणि यः प्राशेत्सततं त्वेकभोजनम् ।
धर्मपत्नीरतो नित्यमग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats only one meal a day for three years, always devoted to his lawful wife, gains the fruit of the Agnishtoma.

verses.text:
द्वितीये दिवसे यस्तु प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादशमासांस्तु जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ।
यज्ञं बहुसुवर्णं वा वासवप्रियमाहरेत् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal only on the second day, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni, would perform a sacrifice with abundant gold, one dear to Indra.

verses.text:
सत्यवाग्दानशीलश्च ब्रह्मण्यश्चानसूयकः ।
क्षान्तो दान्तो जितक्रोधः स गच्छति परां गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Truthful, generous, devoted to Brahmins, free of envy, patient, self-restrained and rid of anger, he goes to the highest state.

verses.text:
पाण्डुराभ्रप्रतीकाशे विमाने हंसलक्षणे ।
द्वे समाप्ते ततः पद्मे सोऽप्सरोभिर्वसेत्सह ॥

meaning.en: In a car like a pale cloud, marked with swans, he then dwells with the Apsaras for two completed padmas.

verses.text:
तृतीये दिवसे यस्तु प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादशमासांस्तु जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal only on the third day, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ।
मयूरहंससंयुक्तं विमानं लभते नरः ॥

meaning.en: gains the peerless fruit of the Atiratra sacrifice and a car yoked with peacocks and swans.

verses.text:
सप्तर्षीणां सदा लोके सोऽप्सरोभिर्वसेत्सह ।
निवर्तनं च तत्रास्य त्रीणि पद्मानि वै विदुः ॥

meaning.en: He dwells with the Apsaras in the world of the Seven Sages; his stay there, they say, lasts three padmas.

verses.text:
दिवसे यश्चतुर्थे तु प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादशमासान्वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal only on the fourth day, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ।
इन्द्रकन्याभिरूढं च विमानं लभते नरः ॥

meaning.en: gains the peerless fruit of the Vajapeya sacrifice and a car mounted by the daughters of Indra.

verses.text:
सागरस्य च पर्यन्ते वासवं लोकमावसेत् ।
देवराजस्य च क्रीडां नित्यकालमवेक्षते ॥

meaning.en: At the edge of the ocean he lives in Indra's world and always watches the sport of the king of the gods.

verses.text:
दिवसे पञ्चमे यस्तु प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादशमासांस्तु जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal only on the fifth day, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
अलुब्धः सत्यवादी च ब्रह्मण्यश्चाविहिंसकः ।
अनसूयुरपापस्थो द्वादशाहफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: free of greed, truthful, devoted to Brahmins, harmless, not envious and free from wrongdoing, gains the fruit of the Dvadashaha sacrifice.

verses.text:
जाम्बूनदमयं दिव्यं विमानं हंसलक्षणम् ।
सूर्यमालासमाभासमारोहेत्पाण्डुरं गृहम् ॥

meaning.en: He rises into a pale mansion, a divine car of Jambunada gold marked with swans, shining like a garland of suns.

verses.text:
आवर्तनानि चत्वारि तथा पद्मानि द्वादश ।
शराग्निपरिमाणं च तत्रासौ वसते सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: There he lives happily for four cycles and twelve padmas, a span measured by the number of reeds and fires.

verses.text:
दिवसे यस्तु षष्ठे वै मुनिः प्राशेत भोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादशमासान्वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: The sage who eats one meal only on the sixth day, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
सदा त्रिषवणस्नायी ब्रह्मचार्यनसूयकः ।
गवामयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: bathing always at the three junctures, celibate and free of envy, gains the peerless fruit of the Gavamayana sacrifice.

verses.text:
अग्निज्वालासमाभासं हंसबर्हिणसेवितम् ।
शातकुम्भमयं युक्तं साधयेद्यानमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: He attains an excellent vehicle of pure gold, blazing like flames of fire and attended by swans and peacocks.

verses.text:
तथैवाप्सरसामङ्के प्रसुप्तः प्रतिबुध्यते ।
नूपुराणां निनादेन मेखलानां च निस्वनैः ॥

meaning.en: There, sleeping in the laps of the Apsaras, he is awakened by the sound of anklets and the tinkling of girdles.

verses.text:
कोटीसहस्रं वर्षाणां त्रीणि कोटिशतानि च ।
पद्मान्यष्टादश तथा पताके द्वे तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: For a thousand crores of years, plus three hundred crores, eighteen padmas and two patakas,

verses.text:
अयुतानि च पञ्चाशदृक्षचर्मशतस्य च ।
लोम्नां प्रमाणेन समं ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ॥

meaning.en: and fifty ayutas, equal to the number of hairs on a hundred bearskins, he is honoured in the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
दिवसे सप्तमे यस्तु प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादशमासान्वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal only on the seventh day, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
सरस्वतीं गोपयानो ब्रह्मचर्यं समाचरन् ।
सुमनोवर्णकं चैव मधुमांसं च वर्जयेत् ॥

meaning.en: guarding the Sarasvati, practising celibacy, and avoiding flower-coloured cosmetics, honey and meat,

verses.text:
पुरुषो मरुतां लोकमिन्द्रलोकं च गच्छति ।
तत्र तत्र च सिद्धार्थो देवकन्याभिरुह्यते ॥

meaning.en: goes to the world of the Maruts and to Indra's world; wherever he goes he succeeds and is carried by divine maidens.

verses.text:
फलं बहुसुवर्णस्य यज्ञस्य लभते नरः ।
संख्यामतिगुणां चापि तेषु लोकेषु मोदते ॥

meaning.en: He gains the fruit of a sacrifice with abundant gold, and he rejoices in those worlds for periods beyond counting.

verses.text:
यस्तु संवत्सरं क्षान्तो भुङ्क्तेऽहन्यष्टमे नरः ।
देवकार्यपरो नित्यं जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: A patient man who eats on the eighth day for a year, always devoted to the gods' rites and offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
पौण्डरीकस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ।
पद्मवर्णनिभं चैव विमानमधिरोहति ॥

meaning.en: gains the peerless fruit of the Paundarika sacrifice and ascends a car the colour of a lotus.

verses.text:
कृष्णाः कनकगौर्यश्च नार्यः श्यामास्तथापराः ।
वयोरूपविलासिन्यो लभते नात्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: Without doubt he gains women, dark ones, golden-fair ones and others of dusky hue, playful in youth and beauty.

verses.text:
यस्तु संवत्सरं भुङ्क्ते नवमे नवमेऽहनि ।
सदा द्वादशमासान्वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats on every ninth day for a year, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ।
पुण्डरीकप्रकाशं च विमानं लभते नरः ॥

meaning.en: gains the fruit of the Ashvamedha sacrifice and a car shining like a white lotus.

verses.text:
दीप्तसूर्याग्नितेजोभिर्दिव्यमालाभिरेव च ।
नीयते रुद्रकन्याभिः सोऽन्तरिक्षं सनातनम् ॥

meaning.en: With the splendour of blazing sun and fire, and with divine garlands, the daughters of Rudra carry him through the eternal sky.

verses.text:
अष्टादशसहस्राणि वर्षाणां कल्पमेव च ।
कोटीशतसहस्रं च तेषु लोकेषु मोदते ॥

meaning.en: For eighteen thousand years, an aeon, and a hundred thousand crores he rejoices in those worlds.

verses.text:
यस्तु संवत्सरं भुङ्क्ते दशाहे वै गते गते ।
सदा द्वादशमासान्वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats each time ten days have passed, for a year, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
ब्रह्मकन्यानिवेशे च सर्वभूतमनोहरे ।
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: in the abode of Brahma's daughters, charming to all beings, gains the peerless fruit of a thousand Ashvamedhas.

verses.text:
रूपवत्यश्च तं कन्या रमयन्ति सदा नरम् ।
नीलोत्पलनिभैर्वर्णै रक्तोत्पलनिभैस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Beautiful maidens always delight that man, with complexions like blue lotuses and like red lotuses.

verses.text:
विमानं मण्डलावर्तमावर्तगहनावृतम् ।
सागरोर्मिप्रतीकाशं साधयेद्यानमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: He gains an excellent vehicle, a car with circular whirls, enclosed in dense spirals, resembling the waves of the sea.

verses.text:
विचित्रमणिमालाभिर्नादितं शङ्खपुष्करैः ।
स्फाटिकैर्वज्रसारैश्च स्तम्भैः सुकृतवेदिकम् ।
आरोहति महद्यानं हंससारसवाहनम् ॥

meaning.en: It resounds with strings of many-hued jewels, conches and drums, and has pillars of crystal and diamond with well-made platforms; he mounts that great vehicle drawn by swans and cranes.

verses.text:
एकादशे तु दिवसे यः प्राप्ते प्राशते हविः ।
सदा द्वादशमासान्वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats his oblation-food on the eleventh day when it comes, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
परस्त्रियो नाभिलषेद्वाचाथ मनसापि वा ।
अनृतं च न भाषेत मातापित्रोः कृतेऽपि वा ॥

meaning.en: not desiring others' wives in word or even thought, and not speaking falsehood, even for the sake of mother or father,

verses.text:
अभिगच्छेन्महादेवं विमानस्थं महाबलम् ।
स्वयंभुवं च पश्येत विमानं समुपस्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: will approach the mighty Mahadeva seated in his car, and will see Svayambhu, whose car stands ready.

verses.text:
कुमार्यः काञ्चनाभासा रूपवत्यो नयन्ति तम् ।
रुद्राणां तमधीवासं दिवि दिव्यं मनोहरम् ॥

meaning.en: Radiant, beautiful maidens lead him to the divine, lovely heavenly abode of the Rudras.

verses.text:
वर्षाण्यपरिमेयानि युगान्तमपि चावसेत् ।
कोटीशतसहस्रं च दश कोटिशतानि च ॥

meaning.en: He lives for unmeasured years, even to the end of the age, a hundred thousand crores and ten hundred crores.

verses.text:
रुद्रं नित्यं प्रणमते देवदानवसंमतम् ।
स तस्मै दर्शनं प्राप्तो दिवसे दिवसे भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: He always bows to Rudra, honoured by gods and demons, and Rudra grants him audience every day.

verses.text:
दिवसे द्वादशे यस्तु प्राप्ते वै प्राशते हविः ।
सदा द्वादशमासान्वै सर्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats his oblation-food on the twelfth day when it comes, for twelve months always, gains the fruit of the Sarvamedha.

verses.text:
आदित्यैर्द्वादशैस्तस्य विमानं संविधीयते ।
मणिमुक्ताप्रवालैश्च महार्हैरुपशोभितम् ॥

meaning.en: A car is prepared for him by the twelve Adityas, adorned with costly gems, pearls and corals.

verses.text:
हंसमालापरिक्षिप्तं नागवीथीसमाकुलम् ।
मयूरैश्चक्रवाकैश्च कूजद्भिरुपशोभितम् ॥

meaning.en: It is ringed with garlands of swans, crowded with serpent-like avenues, adorned with calling peacocks and chakravakas,

verses.text:
अट्टैर्महद्भिः संयुक्तं ब्रह्मलोके प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
नित्यमावसते राजन्नरनारीसमावृतम् ।
ऋषिरेवं महाभागस्त्वङ्गिराः प्राह धर्मवित् ॥

meaning.en: furnished with great turrets and set in the world of Brahma. He lives there always, O king, surrounded by men and women; so the greatly blessed sage Angiras, knower of dharma, declared.

verses.text:
त्रयोदशे तु दिवसे यः प्राप्ते प्राशते हविः ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै देवसत्रफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats his oblation-food on the thirteenth day when it comes, for twelve months always, gains the fruit of a divine sacrificial session.

verses.text:
रक्तपद्मोदयं नाम विमानं साधयेन्नरः ।
जातरूपप्रयुक्तं च रत्नसंचयभूषितम् ॥

meaning.en: He gains a car named Raktapadmodaya, made of gold and adorned with heaps of jewels,

verses.text:
देवकन्याभिराकीर्णं दिव्याभरणभूषितम् ।
पुण्यगन्धोदयं दिव्यं वायव्यैरुपशोभितम् ॥

meaning.en: crowded with divine maidens, decked with divine ornaments, with the fragrance of virtue, and adorned with the winds' gifts.

verses.text:
तत्र शङ्कुपताकं च युगान्तं कल्पमेव च ।
अयुतायुतं तथा पद्मं समुद्रं च तथा वसेत् ॥

meaning.en: There he would dwell to the end of the age, an aeon, and for a myriad myriad years, a padma and an ocean, with banners marking a shanku count of years.

verses.text:
गीतगन्धर्वघोषैश्च भेरीपणवनिस्वनैः ।
सदा प्रमुदितस्ताभिर्देवकन्याभिरीड्यते ॥

meaning.en: With the sounds of song and Gandharvas, with the noise of kettledrums and tabors, he is ever delighted, and the divine maidens praise him.

verses.text:
चतुर्दशे तु दिवसे यः पूर्णे प्राशते हविः ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै महामेधफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats his oblation-food on the fourteenth day when it is complete, for twelve months always, gains the fruit of the Mahamedha.

verses.text:
अनिर्देश्यवयोरूपा देवकन्याः स्वलंकृताः ।
मृष्टतप्ताङ्गदधरा विमानैरनुयान्ति तम् ॥

meaning.en: Divine maidens of indescribable age and beauty, finely adorned and wearing polished, glowing armlets, follow him in their cars.

verses.text:
कलहंसविनिर्घोषैर्नूपुराणां च निस्वनैः ।
काञ्चीनां च समुत्कर्षैस्तत्र तत्र विबोध्यते ॥

meaning.en: Here and there he is awakened by the notes of swans, the sound of anklets and the pull of girdles.

verses.text:
देवकन्यानिवासे च तस्मिन्वसति मानवः ।
जाह्नवीवालुकाकीर्णे पूर्णं संवत्सरं नरः ॥

meaning.en: That man lives for a full year in the dwelling of the divine maidens, strewn with sands of the Ganga.

verses.text:
यस्तु पक्षे गते भुङ्क्ते एकभक्तं जितेन्द्रियः ।
सदा द्वादश मासांस्तु जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ।
राजसूयसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: One who, with senses controlled, eats a single meal once each fortnight, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni, gains the peerless fruit of a thousand Rajasuyas.

verses.text:
यानमारोहते नित्यं हंसबर्हिणसेवितम् ।
मणिमण्डलकैश्चित्रं जातरूपसमावृतम् ॥

meaning.en: He always mounts a vehicle served by swans and peacocks, many-coloured with jewelled circles, overlaid with gold,

verses.text:
दिव्याभरणशोभाभिर्वरस्त्रीभिरलंकृतम् ।
एकस्तम्भं चतुर्द्वारं सप्तभौमं सुमङ्गलम् ।
वैजयन्तीसहस्रैश्च शोभितं गीतनिस्वनैः ॥

meaning.en: adorned with fine women in splendid divine ornaments, with one pillar, four doors and seven storeys, most auspicious, shining with thousands of banners and sounds of song.

verses.text:
दिव्यं दिव्यगुणोपेतं विमानमधिरोहति ।
मणिमुक्ताप्रवालैश्च भूषितं वैद्युतप्रभम् ।
वसेद्युगसहस्रं च खड्गकुञ्जरवाहनः ॥

meaning.en: He mounts a divine car endowed with divine qualities, adorned with gems, pearls and corals and bright as lightning; he lives for a thousand ages, travelling on sword-bearing elephants.

verses.text:
षोडशे दिवसे यस्तु संप्राप्ते प्राशते हविः ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै सोमयज्ञफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats his oblation-food on the sixteenth day when it comes, for twelve months always, gains the fruit of the Soma sacrifice.

verses.text:
सोमकन्यानिवासेषु सोऽध्यावसति नित्यदा ।
सौम्यगन्धानुलिप्तश्च कामचारगतिर्भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: He always dwells in the abodes of the Soma maidens, anointed with Soma's fragrance, moving wherever he wishes.

verses.text:
सुदर्शनाभिर्नारीभिर्मधुराभिस्तथैव च ।
अर्च्यते वै विमानस्थः कामभोगैश्च सेव्यते ॥

meaning.en: In his car he is honoured by lovely, charming women and served with every delight.

verses.text:
फलं पद्मशतप्रख्यं महाकल्पं दशाधिकम् ।
आवर्तनानि चत्वारि सागरे यात्यसौ नरः ॥

meaning.en: That man travels the sea for four cycles, with a fruit like a hundred padmas, an aeon and ten more.

verses.text:
दिवसे सप्तदशमे यः प्राप्ते प्राशते हविः ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats his oblation-food on the seventeenth day when it comes, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
स्थानं वारुणमैन्द्रं च रौद्रं चैवाधिगच्छति ।
मारुतौशनसे चैव ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति ॥

meaning.en: He reaches the realms of Varuna, Indra and Rudra, and those of Marut and Ushanas, and goes to the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
तत्र दैवतकन्याभिरासनेनोपचर्यते ।
भूर्भुवं चापि देवर्षिं विश्वरूपमवेक्षते ॥

meaning.en: There divine maidens attend him with seats, and he beholds the divine sage of Bhur and Bhuvah, the universal form.

verses.text:
तत्र देवाधिदेवस्य कुमार्यो रमयन्ति तम् ।
द्वात्रिंशद्रूपधारिण्यो मधुराः समलंकृताः ॥

meaning.en: There young women of the God of gods delight him, sweet and well adorned, taking thirty-two forms.

verses.text:
चन्द्रादित्यावुभौ यावद्गगने चरतः प्रभो ।
तावच्चरत्यसौ वीरः सुधामृतरसाशनः ॥

meaning.en: As long as the moon and sun both travel in the sky, my lord, so long that hero ranges there, feeding on the essence of nectar.

verses.text:
अष्टादशे तु दिवसे प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै सप्त लोकान्स पश्यति ॥

meaning.en: One who eats only one meal on the eighteenth day, for twelve months always, sees the seven worlds.

verses.text:
रथैः सनन्दिघोषैश्च पृष्ठतः सोऽनुगम्यते ।
देवकन्याधिरूढैस्तु भ्राजमानैः स्वलंकृतैः ॥

meaning.en: Behind him follow chariots with joyful sounds, shining and finely adorned, mounted by divine maidens.

verses.text:
व्याघ्रसिंहप्रयुक्तं च मेघस्वननिनादितम् ।
विमानमुत्तमं दिव्यं सुसुखी ह्यधिरोहति ॥

meaning.en: Very happy, he ascends an excellent divine car yoked to tigers and lions and rumbling like thunder-clouds.

verses.text:
तत्र कल्पसहस्रं स कान्ताभिः सह मोदते ।
सुधारसं च भुञ्जीत अमृतोपममुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: There for a thousand aeons he rejoices with beloved women and enjoys the best essence of nectar, like ambrosia.

verses.text:
एकोनविंशे दिवसे यो भुङ्क्ते एकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै सप्त लोकान्स पश्यति ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal only on the nineteenth day, for twelve months always, sees the seven worlds.

verses.text:
उत्तमं लभते स्थानमप्सरोगणसेवितम् ।
गन्धर्वैरुपगीतं च विमानं सूर्यवर्चसम् ॥

meaning.en: He gains an excellent abode served by hosts of Apsaras, and a car bright as the sun and sung to by Gandharvas.

verses.text:
तत्रामरवरस्त्रीभिर्मोदते विगतज्वरः ।
दिव्याम्बरधरः श्रीमानयुतानां शतं समाः ॥

meaning.en: There, free of fever, wearing divine garments and splendid, he rejoices with the finest divine women for a hundred ayutas of years.

verses.text:
पूर्णेऽथ दिवसे विंशे यो भुङ्क्ते ह्येकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासांस्तु सत्यवादी धृतव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal on the full twentieth day, for twelve months always, truthful and firm in his vow,

verses.text:
अमांसाशी ब्रह्मचारी सर्वभूतहिते रतः ।
स लोकान्विपुलान्दिव्यानादित्यानामुपाश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: eating no meat, celibate and devoted to the welfare of all beings, gains the vast divine worlds of the Adityas.

verses.text:
गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च दिव्यमाल्यानुलेपनैः ।
विमानैः काञ्चनैर्दिव्यैः पृष्ठतश्चानुगम्यते ॥

meaning.en: Gandharvas and Apsaras in golden divine cars, wearing divine garlands and perfumes, follow behind him.

verses.text:
एकविंशे तु दिवसे यो भुङ्क्ते ह्येकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal on the twenty-first day, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
लोकमौशनसं दिव्यं शक्रलोकं च गच्छति ।
अश्विनोर्मरुतां चैव सुखेष्वभिरतः सदा ॥

meaning.en: goes to the divine world of Ushanas and Shakra's world, always delighting in the pleasures of the Ashvins and the Maruts.

verses.text:
अनभिज्ञश्च दुःखानां विमानवरमास्थितः ।
सेव्यमानो वरस्त्रीभिः क्रीडत्यमरवत्प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Knowing no sorrows, seated in an excellent car and served by the finest women, the lord plays like an immortal.

verses.text:
द्वाविंशे दिवसे प्राप्ते यो भुङ्क्ते ह्येकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal when the twenty-second day arrives, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
धृतिमानहिंसानिरतः सत्यवागनसूयकः ।
लोकान्वसूनामाप्नोति दिवाकरसमप्रभः ॥

meaning.en: steadfast, devoted to non-violence, truthful and free of envy, reaches the worlds of the Vasus, shining like the sun.

verses.text:
कामचारी सुधाहारो विमानवरमास्थितः ।
रमते देवकन्याभिर्दिव्याभरणभूषितः ॥

meaning.en: Moving as he wishes and feeding on nectar, seated in an excellent car and decked with divine ornaments, he delights with divine maidens.

verses.text:
त्रयोविंशे तु दिवसे प्राशेद्यस्त्वेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासांस्तु मिताहारो जितेन्द्रियः ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal on the twenty-third day, for twelve months always, moderate in food and in command of his senses,

verses.text:
वायोरुशनसश्चैव रुद्रलोकं च गच्छति ।
कामचारी कामगमः पूज्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः ॥

meaning.en: goes to the worlds of Vayu, Ushanas and Rudra, moving and going where he wishes, honoured by hosts of Apsaras.

verses.text:
अनेकगुणपर्यन्तं विमानवरमास्थितः ।
रमते देवकन्याभिर्दिव्याभरणभूषितः ॥

meaning.en: Seated in an excellent car with limitless excellences, adorned with divine ornaments, he delights with divine maidens.

verses.text:
चतुर्विंशे तु दिवसे यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal on the twenty-fourth day, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
आदित्यानामधीवासे मोदमानो वसेच्चिरम् ।
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरो दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनः ॥

meaning.en: lives long and joyfully in the abode of the Adityas, wearing divine garlands and garments and anointed with divine scents.

verses.text:
विमाने काञ्चने दिव्ये हंसयुक्ते मनोरमे ।
रमते देवकन्यानां सहस्रैरयुतैस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: In a lovely golden divine car yoked with swans, he delights with thousands and tens of thousands of divine maidens.

verses.text:
पञ्चविंशे तु दिवसे यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासांस्तु पुष्कलं यानमारुहेत् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal on the twenty-fifth day, for twelve months always, ascends a splendid vehicle.

verses.text:
सिंहव्याघ्रप्रयुक्तैश्च मेघस्वननिनादितैः ।
रथैः सनन्दिघोषैश्च पृष्ठतः सोऽनुगम्यते ॥

meaning.en: Behind him follow chariots yoked with lions and tigers, rumbling like clouds and sounding with joyful noise,

verses.text:
देवकन्यासमारूढै राजतैर्विमलैः शुभैः ।
विमानमुत्तमं दिव्यमास्थाय सुमनोहरम् ॥

meaning.en: bright, pure and auspicious silver ones mounted by divine maidens, while he rides an excellent, divine, enchanting car.

verses.text:
तत्र कल्पसहस्रं वै वसते स्त्रीशतावृते ।
सुधारसं चोपजीवन्नमृतोपममुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: There he lives for a thousand aeons surrounded by hundreds of women, living on the essence of nectar, supreme and like ambrosia.

verses.text:
षड्विंशे दिवसे यस्तु प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासांस्तु नियतो नियताशनः ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal on the twenty-sixth day, for twelve months always, disciplined and restrained in food,

verses.text:
जितेन्द्रियो वीतरागो जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ।
स प्राप्नोति महाभागः पूज्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः ॥

meaning.en: master of his senses and free of passion, offering oblations to Agni, that greatly fortunate man is honoured by hosts of Apsaras and attains

verses.text:
सप्तानां मरुतां लोकान्वसूनां चापि सोऽश्नुते ।
विमाने स्फाटिके दिव्ये सर्वरत्नैरलंकृते ॥

meaning.en: the worlds of the seven Maruts and the Vasus, in a divine crystal car adorned with all jewels, honoured and delighted by Gandharvas and Apsaras for two thousand ages, in divine splendour.

verses.text:
गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च पूज्यमानः प्रमोदते ।
द्वे युगानां सहस्रे तु दिव्ये दिव्येन तेजसा ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal on the twenty-seventh day, for twelve months always, offering oblations to Agni,

verses.text:
सप्तविंशे तु दिवसे यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासांस्तु जुह्वानो जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: gains vast fruit and is honoured in the world of the gods; living there on nectar, he rejoices fully satisfied.

verses.text:
फलं प्राप्नोति विपुलं देवलोके च पूज्यते ।
अमृताशी वसंस्तत्र स वितृप्तः प्रमोदते ॥

meaning.en: O king, that divine-souled man, seated in an excellent car, dwells in the place frequented by divine sages and royal sages.

verses.text:
देवर्षिचरितं राजन्राजर्षिभिरधिष्ठितम् ।
अध्यावसति दिव्यात्मा विमानवरमास्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Delighting with charming women and in the flush of joy, he lives happily for three thousand ages and aeons.

verses.text:
स्त्रीभिर्मनोभिरामाभी रममाणो मदोत्कटः ।
युगकल्पसहस्राणि त्रीण्यावसति वै सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal on the twenty-eighth day, for twelve months always, with mind and senses subdued,

verses.text:
योऽष्टाविंशे तु दिवसे प्राश्नीयादेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासांस्तु जितात्मा विजितेन्द्रियः ॥

meaning.en: gains the vast fruit won by divine sages; enjoying pleasures, he shines with splendour like the spotless thousand-rayed sun.

verses.text:
फलं देवर्षिचरितं विपुलं समुपाश्नुते ।
भोगवांस्तेजसा भाति सहस्रांशुरिवामलः ॥

meaning.en: Delicate, radiant women with full breasts and hips, adorned with divine ornaments, delight him.

verses.text:
सुकुमार्यश्च नार्यस्तं रममाणाः सुवर्चसः ।
पीनस्तनोरुजघना दिव्याभरणभूषिताः ॥

meaning.en: Beloved women please his mind in a car like the sun, divine and going wherever desired, for a hundred ayutas of aeon-years.

verses.text:
रमयन्ति मनः कान्ता विमाने सूर्यसंनिभे ।
सर्वकामगमे दिव्ये कल्पायुतशतं समाः ॥

meaning.en: One who eats one meal on the twenty-ninth day, for twelve months always, devoted to his vow of truth,

verses.text:
एकोनत्रिंशे दिवसे यः प्राशेदेकभोजनम् ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै सत्यव्रतपरायणः ॥

meaning.en: gains auspicious divine worlds honoured by the king of the gods and the royal sages, and a divine car white as the moon.

verses.text:
तस्य लोकाः शुभा दिव्या देवराजर्षिपूजिताः ।
विमानं चन्द्रशुभ्राभं दिव्यं समधिगच्छति ॥

meaning.en: It is made of gold, adorned with all gems, filled with hosts of Apsaras and resounding with Gandharvas.

verses.text:
जातरूपमयं युक्तं सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ।
अप्सरोगणसंपूर्णं गन्धर्वैरभिनादितम् ॥

meaning.en: There auspicious women in divine ornaments, charming, sweet and ardent, delight him.

verses.text:
तत्र चैनं शुभा नार्यो दिव्याभरणभूषिताः ।
मनोभिरामा मधुरा रमयन्ति मदोत्कटाः ॥

meaning.en: Enjoying pleasures, endowed with radiance and shining like Vaishvanara, he gleams like an immortal in a divine body.

verses.text:
भोगवांस्तेजसा युक्तो वैश्वानरसमप्रभः ।
दिव्यो दिव्येन वपुषा भ्राजमान इवामरः ॥

meaning.en: He goes to the worlds of the Vasus, Maruts, Sadhyas, Ashvins and Rudras, and to the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
वसूनां मरुतां चैव साध्यानामश्विनोस्तथा ।
रुद्राणां च तथा लोकान्ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति ॥

meaning.en: One of tranquil nature who eats a single meal once a month, for twelve months always, would reach the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
यस्तु मासे गते भुङ्क्ते एकभक्तं शमात्मकः ।
सदा द्वादश मासान्वै ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: Feeding on the essence of nectar, splendid and charming to all, he shines like the sun with radiance, body and glory.

verses.text:
सुधारसकृताहारः श्रीमान्सर्वमनोहरः ।
तेजसा वपुषा लक्ष्म्या भ्राजते रश्मिवानिव ॥

meaning.en: Wearing divine garlands and garments, anointed with divine perfumes, devoted to pleasures, the yogi knows no sorrows.

verses.text:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरो दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनः ।
सुखेष्वभिरतो योगी दुःखानामविजानकः ॥

meaning.en: Seated in his car, he is honoured by self-luminous women and constantly worshipped by daughters of the Rudras and of the divine sages.

verses.text:
स्वयंप्रभाभिर्नारीभिर्विमानस्थो महीयते ।
रुद्रदेवर्षिकन्याभिः सततं चाभिपूज्यते ॥

meaning.en: They are of many fine forms, many passions, many sweet ways of speaking and many delights.

verses.text:
नानाविधसुरूपाभिर्नानारागाभिरेव च ।
नानामधुरभाषाभिर्नानारतिभिरेव च ॥

meaning.en: In a car shaped like a city, bright as the sun, moon-like behind him and cloud-like to the north,

verses.text:
विमाने नगराकारे सूर्यवत्सूर्यसंनिभे ।
पृष्ठतः सोमसंकाशे उदक्चैवाभ्रसंनिभे ॥

meaning.en: reddish to the south, with a blue circle beneath and a wondrous gleam above, he lives there alone, honoured.

verses.text:
दक्षिणायां तु रक्ताभे अधस्तान्नीलमण्डले ।
ऊर्ध्वं चित्राभिसंकाशे नैको वसति पूजितः ॥

meaning.en: For as many years as a thousand years of rain falling on Jambudvipa, that many years are declared for the wise one's stay in Brahma's world.

verses.text:
यावद्वर्षसहस्रं तु जम्बूद्वीपे प्रवर्षति ।
तावत्संवत्सराः प्रोक्ता ब्रह्मलोकस्य धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: As many drops as fall from the sky in the rainy season, so many years he lives with the splendour of an immortal.

verses.text:
विप्रुषश्चैव यावन्त्यो निपतन्ति नभस्तलात् ।
वर्षासु वर्षतस्तावन्निवसत्यमरप्रभः ॥

meaning.en: One who fasts for a month, for ten years, gains the best heaven; becoming a great sage, he goes there in his own body.

verses.text:
मासोपवासी वर्षैस्तु दशभिः स्वर्गमुत्तमम् ।
महर्षित्वमथासाद्य सशरीरगतिर्भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: A sage, self-controlled, master of his anger, always in command of belly and sexual desire, offering oblations to the fires, disciplined and attending the twilight worship,

verses.text:
मुनिर्दान्तो जितक्रोधो जितशिश्नोदरः सदा ।
जुह्वन्नग्नींश्च नियतः संध्योपासनसेविता ॥

meaning.en: and one who thus fasts for months with many observances and lives under the open sky: his dwelling is thus described.

verses.text:
बहुभिर्नियमैरेवं मासानश्नाति यो नरः ।
अभ्रावकाशशीलश्च तस्य वासो निरुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: King, having gone to heaven in his own body like an immortal, he enjoys meritorious heaven as he wishes, in due order.

verses.text:
दिवं गत्वा शरीरेण स्वेन राजन्यथामरः ।
स्वर्गं पुण्यं यथाकाममुपभुङ्क्ते यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: Best of Bharatas, I have thus explained to you in order the highest rule of sacrifices, whose substance is the fruit of fasting.

verses.text:
एष ते भरतश्रेष्ठ यज्ञानां विधिरुत्तमः ।
व्याख्यातो ह्यानुपूर्व्येण उपवासफलात्मकः ॥

meaning.en: Partha, by keeping this fast, poor men may obtain the fruit of sacrifices and go to the highest state, if devoted to honouring gods and Brahmins, best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
दरिद्रैर्मनुजैः पार्थ प्राप्यं यज्ञफलं यथा ।
उपवासमिमं कृत्वा गच्छेच्च परमां गतिम् ।
देवद्विजातिपूजायां रतो भरतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: This rule of fasting has been fully described, for the disciplined, the vigilant, the pure and the great-souled,

verses.text:
उपवासविधिस्त्वेष विस्तरेण प्रकीर्तितः ।
नियतेष्वप्रमत्तेषु शौचवत्सु महात्मसु ॥

meaning.en: for those free of hypocrisy and malice, of fixed resolve, steady and unshaken, Bharata; let there be no doubt in you about this.

verses.text:
दम्भद्रोहनिवृत्तेषु कृतबुद्धिषु भारत ।
अचलेष्वप्रकम्पेषु मा ते भूदत्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: Do not let any doubt arise in you about this.
